parsed.explanation: Combined national-state regime imposes universal birth-sex exposures at entry, in government facilities, and in custody, with documented sexual assault after birth-sex prison placement and judicial dismissal of protection claims. Entry officers may refuse on document discrepancy and consider lifetime fraud ineligibility. National hate-crime, housing and employment protections, one city's ordinances, functioning courts enjoining some orders, and no documented police sweeps or execution risk mitigate, but do not offset tier-1 facility/custody rules. Minor visitors face under-19 care and sports bans.

entry_documents.exposure: National binary sex definition, X-marker passports stopped, Supreme Court allowed restrictions Nov 2025; consular cable: document discrepancy or reasonable doubt on sex requires refusal and more evidence, suspected misrepresentation may support permanent fraud ineligibility.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports valid to expiry; fraud finding requires four elements, never automatic, limited waivers; civil-liberties suit and allied advisories show contestation.
entry_documents.interaction: Home-passport marker mismatch can trigger entry refusal, investigation and, if detained, birth-sex custody; state surgery-based marker rules do not directly govern foreign passports.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: National corrections from 2026 adopted model mandating conversion-therapy practices, hair cutting, hormone removal; immigration custody reports of forced labour, beatings, solitary and sexual abuse; state prisoner housed by birth sex, celled with sex offender, assaulted.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: National hate-crime law covers gender identity; courts hear challenges and have enjoined some orders; no documented remedy in 2022 state prison case.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Entry/facilities arrest can lead to birth-sex placement; 2022 judge dismissed failure-to-protect and treatment claims, calling assault injuries de minimis, showing recourse failure in custody.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: National order bars trans people from government-funded single-sex facilities congruent with identity; state 2023 order defines sex at birth and backs single-sex bathrooms/changing rooms; national map shows many states banning government-building access, 4 criminalising in some circumstances.
federal_state_facilities.protection: 29 states plus capital district have no mapped ban; private facilities not generally documented as banned; state inventory does not record a specific state facility-enforcement statute beyond executive endorsement.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Traveller can use many private spaces but faces exclusion, outing and possible trespass referral in government buildings, schools, clinics and capitols.

care_services.exposure: State bans gender-affirming care under 19, upheld 6-1 July 2024; national orders target minor care and proposed insurance bar; adult visitor care denial not documented as state-wide ban.
care_services.protection: Several national orders blocked or enjoined; national housing/employment enforcement does not govern care; no documented adult visitor care protection.
care_services.interaction: Minor traveller or parent seeking care faces categorical state bar; adult emergency ward placement by birth sex is uncertain and not documented.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: National orders frame gender identity as ideology, direct investigations of schools/teachers facilitating social transition, counterterrorism memo uses 'radical gender ideology' and strategy targets 'radically pro-transgender' groups; public opinion 66% supports birth-sex documents.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Orders are contested and several enjoined; strategy states powers not for mere disagreement; marriage and employment rulings remain in force.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Official threat-framing raises outing and enforcement discretion at borders, facilities and schools, even without a trans-specific criminal statute.

minors_guardians.exposure: Under-19 care banned; June 2025 law bars trans athletes from any sports; school association required HRT/surgery evidence; national order directs criminal prosecution of teachers facilitating transition including pronouns.
minors_guardians.protection: Some national orders enjoined; state care ban and sports law documented as operative; no documented visitor exemption.
minors_guardians.interaction: Travelling minor is unlikely to enrol for sports/care, but guardian cannot obtain care in-state and school participation would be barred; short-stay exposure is mainly care/sports denial.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: No state trans homicide/assault statistics documented; national context includes bias incidents and airport screening outing risks; custody sexual assault is main documented violence.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National hate-crime law since 2009; one city since 2012 bans gender-identity discrimination in employment/public accommodations, college system policy 2021; state hate-crime law does not name gender identity.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: National charge available despite state silence, but state enforcement and custody response in documented case were weak; absence of violence data is not safety.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Passport suit unresolved, several orders in litigation/enjoined, state facility-enforcement beyond executive order and current local marker practice not recorded, ward placement not documented.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Courts have enjoined some measures, national fair-housing and employment enforcement operate, legal-aid FAQ exists.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Uncertainty itself is exposure: operative entry, facilities and custody rules may change during travel; remedies exist on paper but 2022 custody ruling shows limited practical relief.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar in routine identity checks, confiscation risk and weak judicial deference in custody, but here entry refusal/fraud consideration and birth-sex custody sexual assault are more severe, while national injunctions and city protections are stronger than 0.35-B's dismissed complaints.

Similar ward/facility placement by documents causing delayed or denied services without certain detention, but this case adds entry refusal, lifetime fraud consideration, and documented custodial assault with denied protection claim, placing it below 0.55-C.

0.75-C has respectful border training, brief detention ending in release, counsel and compensation. Here binary passport policy, discrepancy-based refusal and hostile custody record are documented, so rating is materially lower despite courts sometimes enjoining orders.

parsed.synthesis: Interaction dominates: document discrepancy at entry can become refusal or fraud consideration; any arrest for facilities or other offences can become birth-sex detention where harm is documented and a court denied protection. State executive order plus national facility ban create inescapable government-space exposure for outed visitors, while private spaces, city ordinance, national hate-crime/housing law and enjoined orders provide partial mitigation. For minors, care and sports bans are categorical. No execution or organised sweeps are documented, keeping score above 0.25-0.35, but tier-1 universal exposures keep it in Elevated Risk.
